### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Report all objective measurements and units exactly as stated in the transcript; do not convert units or infer equivalents. Ensure objective findings are explicitly stated as performed by the doctor, not inferred from patient subjective reports.
[A]: Do not infer control status (e.g., 'controlled,' 'stable') for conditions unless explicitly stated by the doctor.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Only include physical exam findings for systems explicitly described by the doctor's objective assessment; do not infer findings for systems merely discussed or subjectively reported.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[O]: Attribute all descriptive adjectives and findings to the precise anatomical location or characteristic they refer to in the transcript; do not reassign or combine descriptors from different elements.
